tour.title: The Drill Lab
tour.body: Drill one set's cases on repeat: recognise, execute, stop. Every case keeps its own times.

tour.title: Pick a set
tour.body: Switch sets here. Learned or All decides which cases come up.

tour.title: Weakest first
tour.body: Your slowest cases come up most often. Random mixes them evenly.

tour.title: Options
tour.body: Hide the algorithm until you're done, time recognition separately, add a random AUF or switch to a 2D view.

tour.title: Time a case
tour.body: Press Space or tap this panel to start, and again to stop.

tour.title: Cases, weakest first
tour.body: Your slowest cases rise to the top. Custom set drills only the ones you pick.

greetings.line: Hi, I'm {name}! Open me any time for a tour of this page.
Welcome back! A short drill now beats a long one next week.
Your slowest cases are at the top. Drill them first?

stretch: That's an hour of drilling. Rest your hands for a minute?

tips: Turn on Recognition split to see how long you take to recognise each case.
Random AUF makes you recognise the case from any angle, like in a real solve.
Ten good reps beat fifty sloppy ones.
